charge_port.notes: GM: the 2027 Bolt is Chevrolet's first vehicle with a native NACS port.

supercharger_access.notes: Native NACS; InsideEVs charged a 2027 Bolt at a Tesla Supercharger with a NACS cable; KBB: plugs directly into compatible Superchargers. US.

adapters_included.notes: Native NACS port. GM sells a CCS1 DC adapter for $189 (J1772 $67, both $256), per Electrek 2026-08-14 relaying GM; no source found that puts one in the box for this model. US only (no Canadian 2027 car). Conflict: Notebookcheck says the 2027 Bolt "comes with a CCS adapter included in its price"; Charged EVs and Electrek both list it as a $189 purchase from Chevrolet, so sold is recorded.
Charged EVs: CCS-to-NACS adapter $189 and J1772-to-NACS $67 available from Chevrolet, sold separately.

wheels.notes: RS page: 17 in aluminum, 215/50R17; the LT (trim index page) is also 17 in.

heat_pump.notes: Charged EVs: fitted with a heat pump for the first time.
Recurrent: Bolt 2027+ yes, listed for all trims.
